coldOpen.line: For almost a hundred years, everyone believed this club was born in 1927. Everyone was wrong.
coldOpen.reveal: Researchers found membership card no. 2, issued in October 1923. The crest was corrected in 2015.

beats.line: A workers' club, born in the labour sports movement of the 1920s.
13 league titles, 16 State Cups, and in 1967 the first Asian club champions.
UEFA Cup 2001/02: Chelsea, Lokomotiv Moscow and Parma knocked out.
Heroes are drawn as paper characters; every 'superpower' is a sourced moment, not an invented nickname.
sources: owner PDF 11.11.2026; facts from the Worker archive
